svg.title: defines a bounded holomorphic periodic matrix function on the collar. On the real axis, diag- onalization reduces the series to the positive scalar square root, so P(p)∗= P(p), P(p)2 = Q(p) √ and √v I ≤P(p) ≤ A I. The Laurent coefficients of Q are real, and conjugation at opposite real momenta preserves the selected branch. Fourier inversion, taking real parts of the coefficients, therefore recovers the same real-axis function.
